name: release-pipeline
description: The full ship-a-sprint factory as a scheduled, bounded, human-gated pipeline. Per-ticket fix→verify loops (judge-convergence stops on success or oscillation), merge to dev, a fanned-out blast-radius QA sweep (nests deploy-fanout-qa) and an end-to-end journey check (nests smoke-test), then judge-release-readiness gates a HUMAN go/no-go at the irreversible boundary, a canary prod deploy, and an automatic rollback if the canary regresses. Every loop is capped; autonomy stops at the reversible boundary.

phases.name: fix-tickets
phases.description: Per-ticket: fix → verify, looping until QA passes or judge-convergence calls it (oscillating/stalled tickets fall out to escalation, they don't block the train). Demo iterates an inline ticket set; in production `over` is ${sprintTickets}.

phases.name: merge-dev
phases.description: Merge the passing tickets to the dev branch (reversible — no human gate here).

phases.name: blast-radius-sweep
phases.description: Scope + fan-out QA across affected components on the integrated build (nested orchestration).

phases.name: journey-check
phases.description: End-to-end journey / lifecycle check that the whole app still works (nested orchestration).

phases.name: release-readiness
phases.description: Compile the evidence into a go/no-go. The irreversible boundary is next — be skeptical.

phases.name: human-approval
phases.description: HITL gate: a human reads the readiness report and approves prod before anything irreversible runs.

phases.name: deploy-prod-canary
phases.description: Promote stage → prod as a canary.

phases.name: canary-check
phases.description: Smoke the canary in prod and report health.

phases.name: canary-decision
phases.description: Healthy → promote; regressed → automatic rollback (reversible mitigation first).

promote.name: complete-rollout
promote.description: Canary healthy — record the release; rollout stands.

rollback.name: auto-rollback
rollback.description: Canary regressed — roll prod back to last-known-good automatically.

default.name: rollback-default
default.description: Unclear canary health — fail safe and roll back.

hold.name: hold-release
hold.description: Not ready — a human reviews the blockers before any retry.
